title: bf16 without ZeRO incorrectly treated as having ZeRO optimizer state in checkpoint
ZeRO3 builds fp16 partitions from full param_groups including frozen params, OOM-equivalent silent waste plus unused optimizer state
root_cause: DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3._setup_for_real_optimizer called _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation() on the raw self.optimizer.param_groups, including frozen params. Frozen params became part of the partitioned trainable list — they were placed into Adam fp32 state and received update increments from optimizer.step, silently un-freezing them.

title: ZeRO-1 fp16 overflow flag broadcast only on partition_gradients path — Z1 ranks diverge on overflow
root_cause: In has_overflow_partitioned_grads_serial, the cross-rank `dist.all_reduce(overflow_gpu, op=MAX, group=dp_process_group)` was guarded by `if partition_gradients`. ZeRO stage 1 is partition_gradients=False, so the all-reduce was skipped. Each rank then made an independent overflow decision: ranks that saw overflow skip the step and shrink loss-scale, ranks that did not see overflow apply the step. After a few overflow events ranks have different loss_scale values and (more critically) different parameter values — DDP-equivalence is broken.
trigger_conditions: some training step where one rank's grads overflow but other ranks' do not

title: BF16_Optimizer skips fp32 cast of gradient when grad_acc_dtype != fp32 — Adam runs on bf16 grads
root_cause: BF16_Optimizer.step() previously assumed param_partition.grad was already in the param's fp32 dtype because initialize_optimizer_states() did the cast at init. When grad_acc_dtype is bf16, that one-shot cast at init becomes meaningless — every subsequent step the bf16-grad accumulator gets reduced into the partition's grad slot but nothing converts it to fp32 before the wrapped Adam.step() reads it. Adam then computes m_t, v_t, and the parameter update entirely in bf16, with corresponding precision loss in the second moment.

title: PipelineEngine non-last-stage backward double-updates hp_grads when bfloat16_immediate_grad_update is enabled
root_cause: PipelineEngine._exec_backward_pass for non-last-stage manually calls self.optimizer.update_hp_grads(clear_lp_grads=False) because backward is invoked via torch.autograd.backward instead of optimizer.backward(). With immediate_grad_update=True the per-param backward hooks already populate fp32_groups_gradients_flat as each lp.grad is produced. The unconditional call to update_hp_grads then iterates every parameter and adds lp.grad to the fp32 accumulator a SECOND time — every gradient on PP non-last stages is doubled.

title: ZeRO-3 partition padding allocated with torch.empty — undefined values get reduced into other ranks' partitions
root_cause: When a parameter's last partition is smaller than partition_numel, _avg_scatter_dense_grads built a padded_partition with `torch.empty(...)` and only copied the valid prefix into it. The trailing pad elements held arbitrary garbage from the GPU allocator. That whole padded tensor was then included in the reduce_scatter, so other ranks received contaminated padding bytes mixed into the next parameter's region (because reduce_scatter sums element-wise across ranks before slicing).
trigger_conditions: any param whose partition_numel > the slice numel for the last rank (requires padding)

title: MoE TopKGate.wg silently rebound to a fresh fp32 Linear under ZeRO+fp16/bf16 — gate weight gradients never applied to the ZeRO-managed parameter
root_cause: TopKGate.__init__ created `self.wg = torch.nn.Linear(...).float()`, registering an fp32 weight with DeepSpeed. When the engine downcasts the model to fp16/bf16, wg.weight becomes fp16/bf16. TopKGate.forward then runs `if self.wg.weight.dtype != torch.float32: self.wg = self.wg.float()` — this creates a brand new Linear module whose weight is a fresh fp32 tensor copy and rebinds self.wg. The new wg.weight is NOT the ZeRO-tracked parameter, so its gradient is never reduced across ranks and the optimizer never updates it. The original (ZeRO-managed) wg.weight stays at its initialization value forever; only the orphan copy receives gradient updates that get thrown away at the end of each step (because the orphan is recreated every forward).
trigger_conditions: ZeRO stage 1/2/3 (which downcasts model parameters from fp32 to fp16/bf16)

title: Fix error in pipeline-parallel schedules to support context parallel
description: get_tensor_shapes() in schedules.py doesn't account for context parallel size, producing wrong tensor shapes for p2p communication between pipeline stages when CP is enabled.
root_cause: get_tensor_shapes() in schedules.py doesn't account for context parallel size, producing wrong tensor shapes for p2p communication between pipeline stages when CP is enabled.

title: Router input jitter dtype bug — silent fp32 promotion
description: MoE router input jitter computation uses wrong dtype, causing numerical inconsistencies in expert routing. The jitter noise is applied with incorrect precision, affecting routing decisions.
root_cause: torch.distributions.uniform.Uniform creates fp32 tensors by default (no dtype arg). Multiplying bf16 input by fp32 jitter silently promotes the result to fp32.

title: Fix: Initialize master_weight with params_dtype directly
description: Master weights are initialized by first creating in one dtype then casting, instead of directly using params_dtype. The unnecessary casting introduces numerical precision loss during initialization, affecting mixed-precision training.
root_cause: Master weights are initialized by first creating in one dtype then casting, instead of directly using params_dtype. The unnecessary casting introduces numerical precision loss during initialization, affecting mixed-precision training.

title: Multi-stream sync problem in model init causes DDP to read uninitialized parameters
description: DDP initialization runs in a separate CUDA stream from parameter initialization. Without proper synchronization, DDP copies parameter values into buckets before initialization completes, capturing garbage or partially-initialized data.
root_cause: DDP initialization runs in a separate CUDA stream from parameter initialization. Without proper synchronization, DDP copies parameter values into buckets before initialization completes, capturing garbage or partially-initialized data.

title: Fix data helpers overflow bug (int32 overflow in sample_idx)
description: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32). When doc_idx_index exceeds int32 range during long training with short-sentence datasets, silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices, feeding incorrect training samples.
root_cause: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32). When doc_idx_index exceeds int32 range during long training with short-sentence datasets, silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices, feeding incorrect training samples.

title: Correctness concern for RoPE in context parallel - position embedding split logic
description: RoPE position embedding split logic for context parallel may not correctly assign sine/cosine values to each CP rank. The reshaping of embeddings by sequence length doesn't properly account for the distributed sequence chunks.
root_cause: RoPE position embedding split logic for context parallel may not correctly assign sine/cosine values to each CP rank. The reshaping of embeddings by sequence length doesn't properly account for the distributed sequence chunks.

title: torch.compile recompile limit breaks autograd graph in PPO loop, silently incorrect gradients
description: In PPO training loops, requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit. This breaks the autograd graph, and c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients.
root_cause: In PPO training loops, requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit. This breaks the autograd graph, and c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients.

title: Learning rate error when continuing training - first step uses old LR value
description: After loading checkpoint with --override-opt_param-scheduler and new LR setting, the first training step still uses the old learning rate from the checkpoint instead of the new configured value.
root_cause: After loading checkpoint with --override-opt_param-scheduler and new LR setting, the first training step still uses the old learning rate from the checkpoint instead of the new configured value.

title: MXFP8 params without DP comm overlap causes NaN loss
description: Using --fp8-param-gather and --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather causes gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN. The gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication.
root_cause: Using --fp8-param-gather and --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather causes gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN. The gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication.

title: Loss error when using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
description: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values with megatron-core 0.10.0. Training proceeds without errors but produces abnormal loss patterns, indicating incorrect attention computation.
root_cause: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values with megatron-core 0.10.0. Training proceeds without errors but produces abnormal loss patterns, indicating incorrect attention computation.

title: Global auxiliary loss gradient incorrectly scaled due to averaging over global token count
description: MoE global aux loss divides by the entire DP group's token count instead of the local micro-batch count, silently shrinking aux-loss gradients by ~DP world-size factor.
root_cause: global_aux_loss not multiplied by dp_size before attaching gradient. Gradient is 1/dp_size too small.

title: Gradient synchronization incorrect when --overlap-grad-reduce and --num-distributed-optimizer-instances > 1
description: DDP post-hook executes on a side CUDA stream due to expand_as inheriting stream affinity, causing reduce-scatter to launch before hook completion and producing silently incorrect gradient values.
root_cause: DDP post-hook executes on a side CUDA stream due to expand_as inheriting stream affinity, causing reduce-scatter to launch before hook completion and producing silently incorrect gradient values.

title: [BUG] Wrong attention gradient in Transformer Engine
description: Fused attention backward pass (fused_attn_bwd) produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models, silently corrupting gradients when using TE fused attention with TP.
root_cause: Fused attention backward pass (fused_attn_bwd) produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models, silently corrupting gradients when using TE fused attention with TP.

title: [Bug]: Attention Mask Ignored in transformer_engine Backend with Packed Sequences
description: TE layer defaults to attn_mask_type='causal' and silently ignores the block-diagonal attention_mask, causing cross-document attention leakage during packed-sequence training.
root_cause: TE layer defaults to attn_mask_type='causal' and silently ignores the block-diagonal attention_mask, causing cross-document attention leakage during packed-sequence training.

title: Possible RoPE frequency format mismatch in MultiLatentAttention when rotary_interleaved=True
description: YarnRotaryEmbedding is instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved from config, generating half-half layout frequencies applied with interleaved logic, silently corrupting positional encodings.
root_cause: YarnRotaryEmbedding is instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved from config, generating half-half layout frequencies applied with interleaved logic, silently corrupting positional encodings.

title: fix(moe): fix the bug where gate was not sliced when kv_head < tp_size
description: MoE gate tensor is not partitioned across TP ranks when kv_head < tp_size, causing all TP ranks to use the full gate instead of their slice, silently producing incorrect routing decisions.
root_cause: MoE gate tensor is not partitioned across TP ranks when kv_head < tp_size, causing all TP ranks to use the full gate instead of their slice, silently producing incorrect routing decisions.

title: Fix bug of reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag
description: When forward_pre_hook is disabled, finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration, so initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.
root_cause: When forward_pre_hook is disabled, finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration, so initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.

title: Optimizer state is empty when save-interval=20
description: When saving checkpoint at iteration 20 with save-interval=20, optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key. The optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints.
root_cause: When saving checkpoint at iteration 20 with save-interval=20, optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key. The optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints.

title: MoE aux loss tracker accumulates twice when activation checkpointing reruns router
root_cause: TopKRouter.aux_loss_load_balancing and seq_aux_loss_load_balancing only checked self.training, not torch.is_grad_enabled(). With activation checkpointing the router forward runs once normally and again under recompute (no grad), and the aux loss tracker was incremented in both passes, doubling the logged values.
trigger_conditions: activation recompute / checkpointing enabled (router runs twice per step)

title: group_limited_topk used hardcoded k=2 instead of num_groups/group_topk
root_cause: group_limited_topk computed group_scores as scores.view(num_tokens, num_groups, -1).topk(2, dim=-1)[0].sum(dim=-1) — the k=2 was hardcoded instead of using num_groups//group_topk. This produced wrong group scores and therefore wrong group selection for token-to-expert routing in DeepSeek-style models.

title: ViT local layer spec uses AttnMaskType.causal instead of no_mask, silently turning bidirectional self-attention into causal
root_cause: get_vit_layer_with_local_spec set self_attention attn_mask_type to AttnMaskType.causal. ViTs require bidirectional attention over patch tokens, so a lower-triangular mask is applied by DotProductAttention every forward pass. The TE path was already correct (no_mask) by an earlier fix; only the local path was missed. Training proceeds normally, but every patch can only attend to earlier patches, distorting visual features.
trigger_conditions: ViT/CLIP encoder built via get_vit_layer_with_local_spec (non-TE local path)
Multimodal training (LLaVA-style) with image patch tokens

title: Interleaved 1F1B forgets to wait on async P2P send before deallocating the source buffer, sending corrupted activations to the next pipeline stage
root_cause: forward_backward_pipelining_with_interleaving issued an isend to the next stage and immediately called deallocate_output_tensor without waiting on send_next_wait_handle. Because isend's HtoD copy is asynchronous, the destination buffer on the next rank could end up with whatever value happened to be left in memory by the time the deallocation reuse cycle began. Training continued with subtly corrupted forward activations propagated down the pipeline.

title: MegatronOptimizer.get_grads_for_norm checks fsdp_param BEFORE precision-aware-optimizer branch, so M-FSDP + precision-aware optimizer reads param.grad._local_tensor instead of decoupled_grad and computes the wrong norm
root_cause: MegatronOptimizer.get_grads_for_norm gated on getattr(param, '__fsdp_param__', False) FIRST and only fell back to the precision-aware decoupled_grad branch when not an FSDP param. With both flags on, FSDP parameters were always read via param.grad._local_tensor instead of param.decoupled_grad. Under precision-aware optimizer, param.grad is None or stale because gradients are written into param.decoupled_grad. The grad norm computation thus used wrong (likely zero) tensors, silently disabling clipping and giving an incorrect global norm for logging.
trigger_conditions: Gradient clipping with grad norm computation

title: config.softmax_scale ignored in attention forward paths
Sequential OLMo block should not have shared layernorm
description: Sequential transformer block 中 attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2，导致两路归一化参数耦合
root_cause: Sequential transformer block 中 attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2，导致两路归一化参数耦合

title: Attention norm modifies the residual stream

root_cause: x = self.attn_norm(x) overwrites the residual variable. Residual connection uses normed input instead of original input.

title: FSDP reduce_dtype=bfloat16 causes output logit norm growth at scale (>4 nodes)
description: FSDP mixed precision 中 reduce_dtype=bfloat16 在多节点（>4 nodes）训练时导致 output logit norm 持续增长，最终导致 PPL 指标出现 Inf，但 loss 仍然正常
root_cause: FSDP mixed precision 中 reduce_dtype=bfloat16 在多节点（>4 nodes）训练时导致 output logit norm 持续增长，最终导致 PPL 指标出现 Inf，但 loss 仍然正常

title: start_index not reset in data loader

root_cause: global_step not reset to 0 when restore_dataloader=False

title: Changed from ignored_index to ignore_index for cross_entropy_loss (flash-attn API change)

root_cause: flash-attn >= 2.5.8 将 cross_entropy_loss 的参数名从 ignored_index 改为 ignore_index，但 OLMo 未同步更新，导致 ignore_index 参数未生效，padding token 被错误地计入 loss

title: SkipStepAdamW step state never incremented

root_cause: optimizer step counter stays at 0, biasing Adam bias correction

root_cause: Context parallelism 下不同 block 复用了相同的 RoPE buffer，导致所有 block 使用相同的位置编码而非各自分片后的位置编码

root_cause: LMHead 在 tensor parallelism 下使用 fused_linear loss 时，ce_loss 和 z_loss 被错误地作为 distributed tensor 组合（应作为 local tensor），且 w_out 缺少 TP wrapper 导致 FSDP 参数分布不一致

title: Fix FSDP+PP stream sync bug: gradient corruption from race condition
description: Pipeline parallelism 的 backward 实现为支持 zero-bubble scheduling 而直接调用 .grad() 并手动累积梯度，但遗漏了 FSDP 的 _root_post_backward_final_callback，导致 reduce-scatter 与梯度读取间的竞态条件

root_cause: FSDP 使用 bf16 reduce_dtype 时，梯度的 accumulation/reduction 操作在 bf16 精度下进行，大规模（48x8 GPU）训练变得不稳定

title: DTensor + python float numeric bug in gradient clipping: epsilon added per-rank instead of once
description: Gradient clipping 中 clip_coef = max_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6) 的 1e-6 在每个 rank 上各加了一次（而非全局加一次），导致 clip coefficient 随 world size 变化
root_cause: Gradient clipping 中 clip_coef = max_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6) 的 1e-6 在每个 rank 上各加了一次（而非全局加一次），导致 clip coefficient 随 world size 变化

title: FSDP use_orig_params + full sharding results in missing parameters in gathered state dict

root_cause: FSDP 在 use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD 策略下，inner module 的 state_dict 缺少部分子模块的参数，而 wrapped model 的 state_dict 包含正确的参数

title: Activation checkpointing dtype mismatch in FSDPv2: skipped type casting in _pre_forward during recomputation
description: FSDPv2 的 _pre_forward hook 在 activation checkpointing 的 recomputation 阶段跳过了 dtype casting，导致 recomputed activation 是 float32 而 saved metadata 记录的是 bfloat16
root_cause: FSDPv2 的 _pre_forward hook 在 activation checkpointing 的 recomputation 阶段跳过了 dtype casting，导致 recomputed activation 是 float32 而 saved metadata 记录的是 bfloat16

title: FSDP with param_init_fn + sync_module_states=True produces random accuracy (model not learning)
description: FSDP 使用 param_init_fn 和 sync_module_states=True 时，因 re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变了参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同，模型实际上无法学习但不报错
root_cause: FSDP 使用 param_init_fn 和 sync_module_states=True 时，因 re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变了参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同，模型实际上无法学习但不报错

title: Meta device initialization on HF models + FSDP leads to different numerical behavior
description: HuggingFace 模型使用 meta device 初始化后再 move to GPU + FSDP wrap，与直接 GPU 初始化相比产生不同的数值结果，即使 buffers/parameters 看起来相同
root_cause: HuggingFace 模型使用 meta device 初始化后再 move to GPU + FSDP wrap，与直接 GPU 初始化相比产生不同的数值结果，即使 buffers/parameters 看起来相同

title: FSDP2 precision issues in reverse process: gradient precision degradation with block-level wrapping

root_cause: FSDP2 对 model block 逐个 fully_shard() 再 wrap 整个模型时，backward 中 text layer 的 gradient 出现精度问题，单 GPU 也能复现

title: Tensor parallelism grad norm incorrectly scaled by world_size instead of DP size
description: TP 模式下 gradient norm scaler 错误地使用 world_size 而非 DP size 来做归一化，导致 gradient clipping 不正确，且 tokens-per-GPU 统计也错误
root_cause: TP 模式下 gradient norm scaler 错误地使用 world_size 而非 DP size 来做归一化，导致 gradient clipping 不正确，且 tokens-per-GPU 统计也错误

title: Fixed bug attempting to save duplicate final checkpoint on restart
description: 训练从 checkpoint 恢复后，trainer 尝试重复保存最终 checkpoint，可能覆盖已有的正确 checkpoint
root_cause: 训练从 checkpoint 恢复后，trainer 尝试重复保存最终 checkpoint，可能覆盖已有的正确 checkpoint

title: RMSNorm uses L2 norm instead of root-mean-square — wrong normalization
root_cause: x.norm(2) is L2 norm (sqrt(sum(x^2))), not RMS (sqrt(mean(x^2)))

title: OLMoSequentialBlock.ff_proj is silently zero-initialized via MuReadout when use_mup is enabled
root_cause: When use_mup was true, ff_proj was constructed as MuReadout with readout_zero_init=True and reset_parameters skipped re-initializing it. Only the final output ff_out should be a MuReadout in muP; every block's ff_proj being zero-initialized wipes out the FFN contribution at start of training. Fix only uses MuReadout for ff_proj when mlp_hidden_size is also set and always re-initializes ff_proj via init_normal.

title: Optimizer metric tensors are kept on CPU, causing per-rank cross-device mismatch on the all_reduce path
root_cause: per_param_min/max/sum/norm tensors were appended without explicit device, defaulting to CPU. The subsequent dist.all_reduce was then performed on CPU tensors while NCCL only supports GPU tensors; this either silently used the gloo backend (different reduction semantics, slower) or returned partially-reduced values when ranks ended up on different devices. Fix forces all metric tensors to the GPU device.

title: MoE load-balance and z-loss aux losses logged without all-reduce, so each rank reports its local value
root_cause: In Trainer the cross-entropy and z-loss were reduced across all ranks before logging, but lb_batch_loss (MoE load-balancing loss) and moe_z_batch_loss were missed. Each rank logged its local value, so the wandb metric reflected only rank 0's mini-batch instead of the global mean, giving misleading load-balance behavior and misreporting MoE training health.

title: FullCheckpointer rebuilds optim state with old parameter keys, dropping state for renamed params after block_group_size change
root_cause: _make_state_dict_compatible returned a remapped state_dict but FullCheckpointer threw away the og_keys_to_new mapping when calling load_fsdp_optim_state. The optimizer state was then loaded against the new model keys without translation, so optimizer state for many params was either silently zeroed or attached to the wrong tensor.
trigger_conditions: training resumes with a different block_group_size than at save time

title: DataConfig defaults memmap_dtype to uint16 silently, so vocab_size > 2^16 truncates token ids on load
root_cause: Before this commit MemMapDataset was constructed without passing a memmap_dtype, defaulting to uint16. When the actual on-disk file was uint32 (because vocab_size > 2^16), reading two-byte chunks silently produced wrong token ids without any type error. Fix exposes effective_memmap_dtype on DataConfig and threads it through build_memmap_dataset.
trigger_conditions: MemMap dataset built from train_config without an explicit dtype

title: DeepSpeed warmup_min_lr=0 instead of base_lr*0.1, also missing warmup_type=linear
root_cause: DeepSpeedTrainer hard-coded `warmup_min_lr=0.0` and omitted `warmup_type='linear'`. Combined, the warmup ramp starts from exactly 0 (rather than 10% of base lr) and uses DeepSpeed's default warmup interpolation, producing a different shape than the OLMo trainer for the equivalent config. Training runs to completion but with a silently mismatched warmup schedule.

title: Qwen3 transformer config defaults rope_full_precision=True, diverging from HF that applies RoPE in bf16
root_cause: TransformerConfig.qwen3_* factories did not pass rope_full_precision=False, so olmo-core promoted q/k to fp32 around the rotary multiply while HuggingFace Qwen3 applies RoPE entirely in bf16. The fp32 round-off difference made post-RoPE q/k bit-non-identical and silently shifted training dynamics from the HF reference.
trigger_conditions: Comparison or weight transfer with HuggingFace Qwen3 reference

title: Idealized-overlap ladder reads dolma2 (uint32) tokens with default uint16 dtype — silently produces garbage token ids
root_cause: PerFileChunkedInstanceSourceConfig defaulted token_dtype to uint16. dolma2 stores token IDs as uint32 because the vocab exceeds 65535. Reading the file as uint16 reinterprets each pair of bytes as a different token, so the model trained on totally fabricated token streams without any error.

title: BLT distill metric not divided by num_micro_batches when grad_accum_steps>1
root_cause: batch_metrics accumulated detached metric tensors across micro-batches without dividing by num_micro_batches, so logged BLT decoder losses were inflated by the gradient accumulation factor while training itself proceeded normally.

title: TE attention backend silently ignored cu_doc_lens — intra-doc masking not applied
root_cause: TEAttentionBackend.forward accepted cu_doc_lens / max_doc_len arguments but did not pass them to TransformerEngine's attn kernel. Documents packed into a single sequence cross-attended each other instead of being masked at boundaries — full attention across all packed docs.

title: Attention gate w_g never initialized — uses uninitialized memory
root_cause: init_attention initialized w_q/w_k/w_v (and w_qkv for FusedAttention) but never touched the optional gate projection w_g. When constructed via nn.Linear with init_device='meta'/'cpu', w_g.weight held whatever values reset_parameters or torch.empty produced rather than the intended trunc-normal distribution.
trigger_conditions: Attention with attention gating (w_g not None)

title: soft_ce branch backprops only alpha*soft_ce — hard_ce gradient zeroed because output.ce_loss is detached
root_cause: The soft-CE branch built combined_loss = (1-alpha)*hard_ce_loss + alpha*soft_ce_loss + z_loss using output.ce_loss and output.z_loss, both of which LMHead returns as .detach()'d copies. Only output.loss carries gradient. As soon as alpha decayed to 0 the entire backward() saw zero gradient and grad_norm collapsed.
trigger_conditions: soft_ce_alpha_start is set so soft-CE branch executes
LMHead returns ce_loss/z_loss as detached tensors via return_logits=True
